result.summary: Category add/update/delete commands now accept project id 0 (ALL_PROJECTS), so global categories can be managed. The delete rules are unchanged. The commands no longer read the legacy `status` payload field, so REST ignores it and only `enabled` sets the category state. Responses never had `status` and still do not. `status` was removed from the ProjectCategoriesAdd/ProjectCategoriesUpdate OpenAPI schemas. No SOAP or UI caller passed `status` to the commands, so SOAP is unchanged. Command and REST tests were added. check-fast and the full check (748 tests) pass.

changes.summary: Accept project_id 0 (ALL_PROJECTS); status comes only from `enabled` (payload `status` ignored).
Accept project_id 0; status comes only from `enabled`, or the current state if `enabled` is absent.
Accept project_id 0; delete checks (default category, issues, project match) unchanged.
Removed `status` from ProjectCategoriesAdd and ProjectCategoriesUpdate schemas.
Added tests: add/update global category; status payload ignored on add and update.
Added tests: delete global category; global default category cannot be deleted; project category not deletable via ALL_PROJECTS.
Added REST tests: `status` ignored on POST/PATCH and absent from responses; CRUD on /projects/0/categories.
Added log entry for this change.

acceptance.criterion: A global category can be added, updated and deleted through the commands
acceptance.evidence: testAddAndUpdateGlobalCategory, testDeleteGlobalCategory, testCannotDeleteGlobalDefaultCategory (tests/Mantis) and testGlobalCategoryCrud (tests/rest) pass.

acceptance.criterion: REST ignores `status`; responses never contain it; OpenAPI requests no longer describe it
acceptance.evidence: testProjectCategoryStatusIsIgnored (REST) and testStatusPayloadIsIgnored (command) pass; `status` removed from both request schemas; npm run api:validate reports the description valid.
7 new tests in 3 test files; 6 ran with `build/local_instance.sh test --filter ...` (OK, 41 assertions) and all 7 ran in the full gate.
composer run check: OK (748 tests, 2578 assertions), including soap suite; composer run check-fast: OK.

harness_gaps.problem: The one-test instructions say rest tests need `composer run dev` running, but do not say that `composer run check` stops the web server at the end; `build/local_instance.sh test --filter X` is the simpler way and is not documented there.
Uses loose `== ALL_PROJECTS`, so a missing project_id is treated as ALL_PROJECTS. Not in scope; noted in the log.
